prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished illustrated CHARACTER SELECTION TRADING CARD for KILLER KAI in The Unknown Universe. Vertical 2:3 portrait, ideally1024x1536. OPAQUE warm cream lined notebook-paper background, thick imperfect hand-drawn black rounded frame, colored-pencil/crayon texture, energetic ink doodles. Image1 is the approved X GOD card layout/style reference ONLY; do not depict X God or copy his lime palette, fire sword or abilities. Image2 is Kai's EXACT approved identity reference: youthful PALE-SKINNED boy with dense CURLY DARK BROWN HAIR, black eyebrows/eyes, small blue/silver temple implant, COBALT BLUE and SILVER cyborg armor, round glowing CYAN chest core, ONE integrated cylindrical CYAN arm cannon and the other robotic hand with fingers, blue/silver boots. No helmet, straight hair, dark skin, second cannon, giant adult anatomy or generic Mega Man costume. Match all his current sprite details. Layout like Image1: large name on rough cyan ribbon across top-left, small black subtitle ribbon beneath it, a starburst badge upper right; central full-body Kai illustration on left, accurate four-row POWER STATS table on right; lower DESCRIPTION box then four ABILITIES rows with hand-drawn icons; bottom black scribble banner. Use cyan/blue accent ribbons instead of lime-green; electric star/circuit doodles and cyan pencil aura near cannon, no background environment or separate poster montage. Keep entire border, title, character feet and all lower rows safely inside image. Bold LEGIBLE ink lettering, precisely the following text, no other invented power numbers or rarity claims:
TOP NAME: 'KILLER KAI'
SUBTITLE: 'CYBORG CANNONEER'
BADGE: 'THUNDER CORE'
TABLE HEADER: 'POWER STATS'
FOUR TABLE ROWS exactly: 'STRENGTH 86', 'SPEED 84', 'DEFENSE 82', 'SPIRIT 88' with red fist, blue bolt, green shield, purple flame icons like reference.
DESCRIPTION HEADER: 'DESCRIPTION'
DESCRIPTION: 'An Earthior schoolmate with a built-in blaster.'
ABILITIES HEADER: 'ABILITIES'
ROW 1 heading: 'ARM CANNON' with small cyan cannon icon. Text: 'Fire rapid cyan energy bolts.'
ROW 2 heading: 'DOUBLE JUMP' with two upward arrows icon. Text: 'Tap jump again in midair.'
ROW 3 heading: 'JET SLAM' with armored downward fist/jet icon. Text: 'Third jump tap slams the ground.'
ROW 4 heading: 'THUNDERFALL' with descending lightning beams icon. Text: 'Punch down. Call lightning from the sky.'
BOTTOM BANNER: 'CHARGE UP. BRING THE THUNDER.'
The central Kai looks confidently friendly and ready, one arm cannon glowing toward lower-left, other fist relaxed, recognizable face and complete curly hair. Make this a polished member of the same hand-drawn card set, with accurate powers and stats, not merely a portrait on a blank background. No watermark or unrelated logo.
